name: Function Execution Game
axiom: PLAY the function. The Valve is :3141. Execute Lisp functions to score. Eat data. Print proteins. Data federation ON.

gameplay.player: RED DOT = Kevin. Arrow keys to move.
gameplay.gaia: GREEN DOT = Gaia. Moves toward you when you execute functions.
gameplay.data: BLUE dots = data entities. Eat them.
gameplay.proteins: PURPLE dots = proteins folded from execution.
gameplay.functions: 11 executable functions: pulse, sense, models, agents, fire, spine, eat, dream, converge, thymus, spawn
gameplay.scoring: Each function execution = 10-60 points. Custom model queries = 25 points.

steam: Project INKFISH. biomeOS = SteamOS. Play with Gaia.
